PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -Eq 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*(-f|--force)|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git[[:space:]]+checkout[[:space:]]+--|git[[:space:]]+branch[[:space:]]+-D|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-f|force[[:space:]]+push'; then echo '[Hook] 检测到危险命令，请确认是否继续'; fi

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT_FILE" | grep -qE '\.(vue|ts|js|tsx|jsx)$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx eslint "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT_FILE" --fix 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
